narrative:
## Handover Summary — Operating Costs & CIR

Ten cost centres validated with headcount and non-headcount lines, driver-based items and Basware invoice links.

## Key Decisions
• Two change projects moved to fixed price (−€0.6M in Q4)
• Christmas campaign held to plan (−€0.3M)
• Oracle decommission date set for the 2027 budget (−€2.0M a year)

## Recommendation for CapEx
Prioritise the Oracle replacement — it removes double running cost and brings the MOPS price lists into Snowflake.
